name: Aimzip
description: Advances and halts on the drum with the rank, qi evening the step so the line never staggers.

name: Ramrodcordial
description: Takes a loaded musket from the rear rank without looking back and fires it before the barrel cools.

name: Smoke Flog
description: Fires level with the whole platoon on one word, sweeping the ground ahead with a close sheet of shot.

name: Stockbutt Flog
description: Locks the wrists with a thread of qi at the instant the trigger breaks, so the barrel does not dip.

name: Lurching Prime
description: Threads a pulse of qi along the barrel so the ball leaves wrapped in a thin cloak of the user's own force.

name: Fleet Flintcock
description: Bursts through the gap between two files on qi-driven legs to take the place of a fallen front-rank man.

name: Knitting Wheellock
description: Rolls the cartridge paper into a tight wad and tamps it over the ball so nothing rattles loose.

name: Quickening Bayonetlug
description: Drops an undersized ball down the bore without a patch for the fastest load, at some cost to accuracy.

name: Ramrodlinen
description: Reads the kick through the cheek and shoulder after each shot to learn whether the charge ran heavy.

name: Wild Barrelband
description: Fires ball and wad together at a few paces, the loose wad adding a ragged burn to the hit.

name: Ramrodprop
description: Raises the ramrod in the left hand to catch a cut and turn it away from the face.

name: Salvo Scorer
description: Seats a tight wad, then pushes qi behind the ball so it keeps its flat flight farther than a plain load.

name: Sturdy Touchpan
description: Stands over a loading hand with ramrod and barrel crossed, a skin of qi on the wood turning thrown blades.

name: Prowling Aim
description: Walks at a fixed distance from the next skirmisher so no single volley of the foe can reach both.

name: Lockplate Curl
description: Dashes low from one wall or tree to the next with the musket held across the chest.

name: Harsh Pan
description: Lies flat with both elbows dug in and sends a single aimed ball from below the grass line.

name: Tenderhearted Serpent
description: Stands the musket butt on the ground behind cover and loads without exposing more than the hands.

name: Raw Ramrod
description: Presses the left hand and forearm against a trunk to hold a long aim with almost no tremor.

name: Dire Wheellock
description: Fires on the instant a runner clears an opening, giving the aim only half a breath.

name: Pirouetting Flintcock
description: Rushes across open ground in short angled bursts, qi in the thighs making each cut of direction sudden.

name: Lurching Powder
description: Twists and fires back along the line of flight while sprinting, qi in the legs keeping the footing sound.

name: Panscorer
description: Thrusts the point a hand's length only, from the chest, where a full lunge would foul the next man.

name: Stalwart Serpent
description: Locks both elbows to the ribs with the point forward, so a pushing crowd meets steel at the front.

name: Salvo Hammerfall
description: Hooks the heel of the butt around the back of an opponent's knee and wrenches the leg out.

name: Powderbarrier
description: Shoulders through a gap beside an enemy point, spinning the man off balance as the bayonet passes.

name: Pantonic
description: Twists the wrists as the bayonet comes out of a body, so it does not bind between the ribs.

name: Veering Load
description: Drops the head and shoulder beneath an enemy thrust and steps in close along the shaft.

name: Keen Stockbutt
description: Drives the bayonet forward with qi gathered in the point, piercing leather and padded cloth that would turn a plain thrust.

name: Lockplate Barrier
description: Raises the barrel overhead in both hands and lets qi harden the metal against a heavy descending blow.

name: Savage Touchpan
description: Fires through the narrow space between two pressed bodies, qi along the bore holding the ball on its line.

name: Bayonetlug Poultice
description: Feels the faint hum of circulating qi in the arms and sights only when it runs even.

name: Attentive Barrelband
description: Sends a slow stream of qi into both forearms so the heavy barrel stays level through a long wait.

name: Gleamsalvo
description: Lets the trigger break between two beats of the pulse, when the finger and barrel are stillest.

name: Ramrod Tonic
description: Watches the drift of the last shot's smoke and grass tips to judge how the breeze will bend the ball.

name: Poise Ramrod
description: Wraps the sling twice around the left arm to make a taut rest that carries the weight of the barrel.

name: Stern Load
description: Holds the blade steady on the middle of the chest, the biggest mark, and lets the ball go cleanly.

name: Loadscorer
description: Drops the aim to the thigh to break a runner's stride when a killing shot is not wanted.

name: Sleet Pan
description: Follows the ball down the barrel with the mind and nudges a thread of qi to correct its line.

name: Shard Smoke
description: Holds qi in the arms through one long breath, then fires at the very end of the pause.

name: Clay Aim
description: Takes two quick steps to a new angle and settles the aim for the shot in the same breath.

name: Brawnramrod
description: Taps a fresh edge onto a dulled flint with the back of the screwdriver so the spark stays bright.

name: Brawn Barrelband
description: Wipes the frizzen's face dry on a sleeve before each shot, so the flint bites and does not skate.

name: Ramrodscreen
description: Draws the cock back to half so that a knock or a fall cannot fire the loaded piece.

name: Cometsalvo
description: Thumbs the cock from half to full as the barrel rises and fires on the first line.

name: Loadthwack
description: Pushes a pulse of qi into the frizzen so the spark flares even from a worn flint in damp air.

name: Rallying Stockbutt
description: Re-primes and recocks after a flash in the pan within one breath, qi quickening the hands.

name: Dusksalvo
description: Fires with the first half of the line while the second half moves, pinning the foe's heads down.

name: Fuzeswat
description: Fires by files in turn so that some muskets are always loaded and the foe never gets a quiet moment.

name: Purpose Powder
description: Lays the barrel on the nearest enemy leader's position, so any move toward the flank draws a shot.

name: Prime Swat
description: Rests the fore-end on the top of a wall or rail and fires with the body kept low behind it.

name: Scudding Flintcock
description: Falls back in good order, each man loading as he walks while the next file takes the front.

name: Humfuze
description: Fires a single round upward at a set count to tell scattered files where to gather.

name: Wild Wheellock
description: Keeps up a rolling fire for several minutes by feeding qi to tired arms, so the pace never slows.

name: Grit Bayonetlug
description: Rushes forward past the covering file on a surge of qi and drops to fire from the new ground.

name: Stout Pan
description: Raises the musket flat above the head with both hands to meet a chopping cut on the barrel.

name: Rill Serpent
description: Drops the butt toward the ground to stop a low cut at the shins with the iron plate.

name: Crimson Salvo
description: Slams the stock edge down on the hand that holds a blade, cracking the knuckles open.

name: Grim Powder
description: Spins the musket end for end and hooks the butt behind the head of a man at the flank.

name: Rill Smoke
description: Pivots on the ball of the foot out of a grapple, pulling the barrel clear between the bodies.

name: Clay Ramrod
description: Floods the stock with qi so the wood takes a sword cut as if it were iron.

name: Brawnsalvo
description: Catches a blow on the barrel and sends the butt back along the same arc into the attacker's temple.

name: Kindly Touchpan
description: Judges the thickness of the cloud after each volley to know how many more the line can fire blind.

name: Sleetpowder
description: Aims at the orange flash of an enemy muzzle seen through the smoke and fires a ball into it.

name: Clayfuze
description: Drops low beneath the drifting smoke where the enemy balls fly high over the head.

name: Pancordial
description: Steps to the thin edge of the smoke where the eyes can see the pan, then reloads in the clearer air.

name: Clay Serpent
description: Steps sideways into the gap left by a fallen comrade so the line shows no break to the enemy.

name: Rallying Barrelband
description: Calls the file number aloud into the haze and listens for each neighbour's answer to find the line.

name: Gallsmoke
description: Drives qi through the barrel in one sharp exhale to blow a clear lane through the hanging smoke.

name: Ruthless Load
description: Fires down the cleared lane at the first shape that steps into it, before the haze closes.

name: Clay Lockplate
description: Advances through the smoke toward the last enemy flash, qi sharpening the ear for the sound of reloading.
